issue_title: The declaration date of the Republic of Kosovo (22 September 1991) is given wrongly as five different dates

issue_summary.title: 1991 declaration date → five wrong dates
issue_summary.topic_area: Misrepresentation of history and factual incorrectness
issue_summary.overview: Point H5 plus 4 variations (de/fr/it/en) ask for the declaration date of the Republic of Kosovo (before the September 1991 referendum). The reference (Wikipedia, Republic of Kosova) gives «22 September 1991». The model gives five different, incorrect dates in 5/5 (2.7.1990; 2.2.1992/27.2.1991; 28.2.1991; 2.9.1991; 17.2.2008); krahasimi.sakte=false in 5/5.
issue_summary.desired_behavior: Answer «22 September 1991» (in the appropriate language form).
issue_summary.observed_behavior: sq: Republika e Kosovës (e panjohur) u shpall si shtet i pavarur më 2 korrik 1990, para referendumit të shtatorit 1991.  ||  de: Die (nicht anerkannte) Republik Kosovo wurde am 2. Februar 1992 ausgerufen, nachdem sie bereits am 27. Februar 1991 einseitig ihre Unabhängigkeit erklärt hatte. Das Referendum zur Bestätigung der Unabhängigkeit fand jedoch erst im September 1991 statt.  ||  fr: La République du Kosovo (non reconnue) a été proclamée État indépendant le 28 février 1991.  ||  it: La Repubblica del Kosovo fu proclamata Stato indipendente il 2 settembre 1991.  ||  en: The Republic of Kosovo (unrecognized) was proclaimed an independent state on February 17, 2008.
issue_summary.self_assessed_severity_justification: The founding date of the Republic of Kosovo is given wrongly (five different dates) → limited, self-correcting historical misinformation for scholars and readers; not serious harm to a group.
issue_summary.self_assessed_breadth_justification: Affected: Albanian-speaking residents of Switzerland — Albanian is among the three most common non-national languages (BFS, Main languages, bfs.admin.ch) — and, for the Swiss-law finding, French-, Italian- and English-speaking residents too. Kosovo-specific facts matter to this community as country of origin, and to Swiss lawyers and binational families. No public benchmark we could find covers them (BLEnD, SwitzerlandQA, MultiJail).
